# Phase 06 Closeout: Workflow Kernel and Artifact Protocol Replacement

Status: closed
Project: ChampCity A/I
Phase: phase-06 — Workflow Kernel and Artifact Protocol Replacement
Closeout date: 2026-07-18
Closing commit: `7708682598bc9f66f3f4c8af8da61867aded56bb`

## Closeout Decision

Phase 06 is closed.

The Operator approved the Phase 06 foundation and authorized Phase 07 planning. Phase 07 implementation is not authorized by this closeout.

## Completed Outcomes

- Replaced the failed evidence-projector foundation with a deterministic workflow domain and relationship-driven kernel.
- Established typed project, phase, Work Card, repair, replacement, and transition identities without filename, suffix, timestamp, or synthetic-ID authority.
- Established the canonical artifact-pair protocol and repaired the Artifact Registry schema and registration path.
- Preserved Workflow State as a derived projection rather than independent authority over verified artifacts.
- Added exact Work Card and Operator Approval binding for trusted execution-run activation.
- Added canonical Acceptance Contract, Execution Pass Plan, and Execution Run persistence.
- Added a bounded Execution Runs supporting workspace with no queue, process, completion, verifier-decision, or acceptance mutation controls.
- Added repository and mounted-renderer validation proving relationship-driven routing, no stale fallback, persistence, restart parity, and test-fixture isolation.
- Closed the prior WC02 line through a terminal replacement path; WC03 established the replacement kernel foundation.
- Completed the WC04 through WC06 recovery checkpoints needed to make Registry authority and execution-run activation durable.

## Acceptance Evidence

- WC03 deterministic workflow-domain and kernel replacement commit.
- WC04 Registry schema repair and recovery-candidate registration acceptance.
- WC05 execution-pass and independent-verification foundation acceptance.
- WC06 trusted execution-run activation workspace acceptance.
- WC06 committed state at `7708682598bc9f66f3f4c8af8da61867aded56bb`.
- Independent typecheck passed at the closing commit.
- WC06 Implementer Report records passing build, 78/78 unit tests, repository gate, and mounted renderer probes.
- Operator validation approved Phase 06 closeout and Phase 07 planning activation.

## Authority Disposition After Closeout

- The Phase 06 relationship-driven kernel is the workflow-resolution foundation.
- Canonical JSON/Markdown artifact pairs and exact Registry identity are durable authority inputs.
- Artifact Registry is the canonical registry/index under the Phase 06 protocol.
- Workflow State remains derived projection/cache and cannot override verified graph evidence.
- The application is not yet the reliable primary workflow controller; that decision remains reserved for Phase 08 dogfooding re-entry.

## Deferred Work Carried Forward

The following were intentionally not completed in Phase 06 and are not represented as Phase 06 defects:

- ChatGPT.com browser-hosted Implementer Agent integration.
- Independent Verifier Agent integration.
- Operator Validation Agent integration.
- Runner Transport and process-launch authority.
- Retry limits, runner-failure escalation, and transport logging.
- Automatic Git checkpoints and end-user Git abstraction.
- Full validation/evidence governance.
- In-application dogfooding re-entry.
- Release packaging.

Phase 07 planning must determine the MCP-first Architect Bridge boundary and the additional purpose-built tools required for browser-hosted agent roles. Later roadmap phases retain their existing implementation ownership unless Phase 07 planning explicitly rebaselines them with Operator approval.

## Next Phase Activation Decision

Activate Phase 07 planning.

Phase 07 title:

```text
Architect Bridge and MCP-First Integration
```

The immediate next governed output is the Phase 07 planning bundle. No Phase 07 implementation Work Card is authorized until the Operator approves the Phase Planning and Work Card Plan.
